citations.exact_line: - `family_control_claims` is a list of objects containing exactly one of `name` or `property`, with its value a public family-control identifier above, plus required `scope` equal to `corpus_variant` or `audit_probe`. Optional allowed fields are `source_family_key,evidence_manifest,control_id,pair_sample_ids,probe_id`; no other fields are allowed. Optional source_family_key must equal the row's family. evidence_manifest is a nonempty relative provenance string and is not credited as proof. control_id is a nonempty descriptive evidence key. pair_sample_ids, when supplied, is a two-element list of distinct actual same-family corpus IDs and requires corpus_variant scope. probe_id, when supplied, is a nonempty identifier of an actually executed same-family probe and requires audit_probe scope. Neither pointer/ID existence nor a producer claim can replace an independently reconstructed relationship. Conflicting name/property, unknown identifier/scope, duplicate claim identifiers with inconsistent scope, mismatched families and undeclared fields are errors.
citations.proposition: General v1 shape permits optional evidence fields; descriptive control keys are not proof and inconsistent scope is forbidden.
